TaskRetry.hint: This is a new attempt at the same ordinary task, not an XP reroll. Apply at least one paid Effort level; Edge still reduces its point cost. Previous costs and results remain.
TaskRetry.label: Task being attempted again
TaskRetry.duration: Original duration (same duration for this attempt)
TaskRetry.confirm: I confirm this is the same task, takes the same time, and remains possible in the fiction.
TaskRetry.blocked: The GM has ruled that further attempts at this task are impossible.
TaskRetry.unavailable: This card is not an eligible failed ordinary task, or its recorded task has already succeeded.
TaskRetry.continued: This failed attempt has already led to a new attempt. Use the latest eligible failed card.
TaskRetry.interrupted: A new attempt was interrupted after its checkpoint. Do not replay it; ask the GM to reconcile the action, costs and chat.
TaskRetry.invalid: The new attempt was refused. Check paid Effort, current resources, duration and action availability.
TaskRetry.reconcile: First reconcile the actual action usage, costs and any published result. Confirming closes this interrupted predecessor; it does not refund points, roll again or restore previous state.
TaskRetry.closed: The interrupted predecessor was closed after explicit GM reconciliation.
